info.title: An EgG
info.author: daniel barros (LF)
info.description: a stupid game about stupid eggs
info.details:
An EgG is a Wii U game about doing stupid things with eggs on an infinite desk. Throw them, fry them, scare them, feed them to a giraffe, and complete quests that get increasingly ridiculous. Get lost in caves, bounce through pinball land, buy questionable stuff, and definitely don’t press the button that summons UNDEF. ...You’re going to press it, aren’t you?

Suggested age: 13+ — includes giraffe butchering and meat imagery.

AI use: AI-generated, not reviewed line by line. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.

changelog: 0.1.0: first public release. not that many bosses right now so i won't count it as 1.0.
